_about: Recorded from one-atlas-edlg.atlassian.net on 2026-11-20 (Codegeist demo site, seeded by outrider-seed). Only fields the Jira adapter reads are kept.

fields.summary: Cannot log in - getting error on login page

content.text: I'm unable to log in to my account. When I enter my credentials, the page shows a generic error message. This started about 30 minutes ago. I've tried clearing cache and a different browser - same result. Other colleagues are also affected. We use this system for all customer-facing work and this is blocking our entire team.

fields.summary: VPN gateway unresponsive for remote workers

content.text: The corporate VPN gateway at vpn.corp.internal is not accepting new connections. Existing sessions are unaffected. Remote workers are unable to connect and the connection times out. Network team is investigating firewall rule changes deployed at 08:30 UTC.

fields.summary: Database connection pool exhausted on primary DB cluster

content.text: The primary PostgreSQL cluster is showing connection pool exhaustion. Applications dependent on db-primary are failing with too many connections errors and dashboards are loading slowly. DBA team notified. Workaround: restart app servers to release idle connections.

fields.summary: Login service is experiencing intermittent failures

content.text: Users across multiple regions are reporting inability to log in and see a generic error message on the login page. The auth service is returning 503 errors. First reported at 09:00 UTC. Affecting approximately 30% of login attempts. Auth team is investigating. Service: auth-service.

fields.summary: VPN connectivity failure after firewall policy update

content.text: Remote workers unable to connect to VPN following a firewall policy update. Existing sessions were unaffected. New connection attempts timed out at the gateway after 60 seconds.

fields.summary: Database query slowness caused by missing index on requests table

content.text: Support agents reported slow queue loading and reports timing out. Database monitoring showed queries against the requests table taking 8-12 seconds. Table scan on 4M rows.

fields.summary: Login service failure due to expired SSL certificate

content.text: Users reported login failures with SSL handshake errors and a generic error message on the login page. The auth service was returning 503 responses. Investigation found the SSL certificate on the load balancer had expired. Affected approximately 40% of login attempts for 2 hours.

fields.summary: Has something changed with Dashloop? Getting sync error

content.text: Hi, I need help with Dashloop. I've recently encountered a couple of issues that I need assistance with:
The analytics data on my dashboard is not displaying correctly. I noticed this started about a week ago after updating to the latest version of Dashloop on my iPhone.
I'm having trouble syncing Dashloop across my devices. I receive an error message saying "Sync failed due to network issues."
I would appreciate your guidance on resolving these issues. Thank you in advance for your assistance.
Has something changed with Dashloop, the network, or the syncing process? My dashboards stopped updating about an hour ago.
